description: Listed building consent for the formation of two new brickwork buttresses to the existing boundary wall, to be positioned either side of the existing entrance to Capel Manor College. Introduction of new painted steel ties through the existing brick wall with spreader plates located on the wall face, in various locations to be determined following further investigation. Reformation of the wall capping arrangements.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (7307-01-D, 7307-02, 7307-03-A, 7307-04, 7307-05-A, 307-06, 20529-1.05 Design & Access Statement Heritage Statement  Received: 04/01/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
